evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 畅和堂
evidence.summary: South-west corner, by the Hanlin garden 澄怀园: from 1732 Ertai's 晚香园, then Yin Jishan's 寻春园, derelict after 1770, rebuilt 1813. Gate 松路花龛 of three bays, main hall five bays in two rolls with side halls 澄霞宇 and 开襟馆, and a square pavilion 森翠. West of its wall is the Hanlin garden 澄怀园.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.
